name: backend-pack
description: 백엔드 로직·데이터 정합성·보안·API·장애 복구·성능·배포 경로를 실제 인프라 맥락에 맞춰 검토한다.
scope: Backend and supporting infrastructure for the requested behavior. Client code may be traced as a consumer; no standalone visual/frontend audit.

members.when: Pin scope, code/deployment evidence and one shared investigation plan.
Trace backend behavior and required invariants.
Assess relevant test oracles and actual verification coverage; execution still follows permissions.
Persistent/shared state, concurrent writes, transactions, cache consistency or migrations.
External input, uploads, authentication, authorization, tenants or sensitive data.
API, event, file-format or consumer compatibility.
Network calls, jobs, timeouts, retries, partial failure or external side effects.
Data scale, hot paths, buffering, caches, pools or resource lifetimes.
Deployment/configuration/runtime limits, CI, rollback or observability affects the reviewed path.
Responsibility/abstraction boundaries materially affect behavior or remediation.
Verify findings and coverage even if no findings were produced.
Findings or decisions move to another agent/session, explanation or implementation; reuse the canonical evidence record.
The user asks for a visual/web explanation of the findings; a review request alone is insufficient.
